thanks: Thank you. Your suggestion is in the list as "proposed".
coversMissing: {n} suggestion(s) without a cover. The module looks for them on its own, a few at a time; the button starts the search right now.
coversNoKeyHint: {n} suggestion(s) without a cover, because covers are not connected yet: open the “Game covers” module.
coversLast: Last automatic search: {date} (UTC) — {found} found, {none} with no result.
coversDeniedHint: Access to covers is refused: check it in the “Game covers” module. The search resumes in 24 hours, or when you click the button.
coversNoKey: Covers are not connected yet: open the “Game covers” module, then run the search again.
coversDenied: Access to covers is refused (wrong, disabled or expired). Check it in the “Game covers” module, then run the search again.
coversDown: The cover site cannot be reached right now. Nothing was changed: try again later.
coversDone: Search finished: {found} cover(s) found, {none} with no result.
coversAmbiguous: For these suggestions, the cover may belong to another game.
coversMore: {left} left to try: run the search again.
rawgBanner: Covers are not connected to the site yet, so suggestions will have no image. Open the “Game covers” module once.
rawgSuggestReason: finds the cover pictures of your games
addStatusHelp: "Rejected" hides the game from the public.
addImageHelp: Only if the cover is not found.
manyHelp: One game per line, {max} at most at a time.
errStatus: Pick a status from the list.
errTitleEmpty: Write the name of the game, for example: Celeste.
errTitleLong: This name is too long ({max} characters at most). Keep only the name of the game, for example: Celeste.
errLongShort: name too long ({max} characters at most).
errNoteLong: The note is too long ({max} characters at most). Keep the essentials in a few words.
errImage: This address does not work. It must start with https://, with no spaces, for example: https://example.org/cover.jpg
errDup: "{title}" is already in the list ({status}). To change its status, use the ⋯ menu on its row.
errManyEmpty: Write at least one game, one per line. For example: Celeste, then on the next line Hollow Knight.
errManyTooMany: Too many games at once: {n} lines, {max} at most. Send {max}, then the rest.
errManyIntro: Nothing was added. Here is what to fix.
errManyOutro: Remove or fix these lines, then send again.
errFull: The list is full ({max} games). Delete some games in the table to add more.
errRoom: There is only room for {n} more games (the list keeps {max} at most). Remove some lines or delete games in the table.
errRoom_one: There is only room for 1 more game (the list keeps {max} at most). Remove some lines or delete games in the table.
coverFound: The cover was found by itself.
coverNone: No cover found: you can pick the image yourself ("Change the cover" on its row).
coverLater: The cover will be looked up a little later, by itself.
coversFoundMany: Covers found: {found}. The others are looked up later, by themselves.
coverStateNone: This game has no cover yet.
adminIntro: Here are the games your audience suggested and those you add. The ⋯ menu of a row changes its status.
searchPlaceholder: Search for a game, a nickname, a status
tableEmpty: No suggestion yet. Add a game above or share the suggestions page.
manyExample: Celeste, then on the next line Hollow Knight
